description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the BWRM (Broadway Web Resource Manager) component, specifically related to the 'Cosa' package concerning the 'BwrmCookedPage' object. It includes getter and setter functions for various properties such as root path, page path, owner reserved handle, page context, timestamp, and reference counting, as well as a function to match paths.

methods.name: BwrmCpoGetRootPath
methods.description: Retrieves the root path property from the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoSetRootPath
methods.description: Sets the root path property for the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoGetPagePath
methods.description: Retrieves the page path property from the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoSetPagePath
methods.description: Sets the page path property for the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoGetOwnerReserved
methods.description: Returns the owner reserved handle from the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoSetOwnerReserved
methods.description: Sets the owner reserved handle in the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoGetTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp associated with the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoIncRefCount
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoDecRefCount
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the object instance.

methods.name: BwrmCpoMatchPath
methods.description: Checks whether the given root path and page path match according to some criteria.
